title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Smoother activation on resource heavy projects
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.33.3 fixes a potential slowdown during activation on projects with many Android resource files by capping concurrent R-index reads.

highlights.title: Bounded R-index Activation Reads
highlights.description: Caps concurrent file reads during startup at 16, keeping activation smooth on projects with many Android resource files.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Capped R-index activation reads at 16 concurrent files, preventing potential slowdowns or file-handle exhaustion when a project has many Android resource files. Applies to both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes to extension behavior in this release.
